class Base { public function run($v){echo __CLASS__,"/",static::class,":",func_num_args(),":",func_get_arg(0);} public static function stat($v){echo "S:",$v;} }
class Leaf extends Base {}
function carry($v){return "F:".$v;}
$cb=[new Leaf,"run"]; $cb(...["v"=>"x"]); echo "|"; ('Base::stat')(v:"y"); echo "|"; $f="carry"; echo $f("z");
purpose: Keep ordinary public target carriers and registered function strings while scoped routes are added.
